setupPage.title: Set up {name}
setupPage.description: No configuration file exists on this machine yet. Answer these and Rooks writes rooks.config.json; anything you leave alone keeps its default.
setupPage.binariesHint: Rooks detects them on its own. One is enough to get started.
setupPage.appEnabled: Let the daemon serve the web interface itself (no Docker)
setupPage.restartWebHint: Restart the daemon to apply your configuration.
setupPage.restartDesktopHint: Restart Rooks to finish setup. The app will close and reopen automatically, keeping your account and settings.
setupPage.remoteAccessIntro: Optional, and it can wait: to reach Rooks from your phone or another computer, put both machines on the same Tailscale network. Nothing gets exposed to the public internet.
setupPage.remoteAccessAppHint: Install Tailscale on the device you want to use — desktop app or mobile app — and sign in with the same account as this machine. Rooks then answers at its address on your tailnet.
setupPage.remoteAccessCliHint: Run the commands shown here on the machine hosting Rooks, not on the device you connect from. Tailscale terminates HTTPS; Rooks keeps listening in clear on loopback.
setupPage.remoteAccessTargetUnknown: No sharing command is available because the local web address is unknown. For Docker or a reverse proxy, check which local address serves Rooks on the host before configuring Tailscale Serve.
setupPage.remoteAccessConsoleHint: HTTPS certificates must be enabled for your tailnet in the Tailscale admin console, otherwise the second command refuses to serve.
setupPage.restartFailed: Rooks could not restart automatically. Your configuration is saved. Try again, or quit and reopen Rooks with the same data directory.
setupPage.portableWarning: In portable mode the daemon runs inside the desktop client: your agents stop when you quit the application.
setupPage.serviceWhy: Rooks installs its daemon as a service so your agents keep running after you close the window. This is required to continue.
setupPage.serviceRunning: The service is installed and running.
setupPage.serviceMissing: The service is not running yet.
setupPage.resumeTitle: This machine already holds a Rooks instance
setupPage.resumeFound: Found here: {agents} agent(s) of your own, {projects} project(s) and {missions} mission(s). Its configuration file is missing, which is the only reason you are on this screen.
setupPage.resumeHint: Writes the missing configuration and opens the app. Nothing is created, renamed or overwritten.
setupPage.prerequisitesAllFound: Everything this machine needs was found. Installed something else by hand? Re-detect looks again, no restart needed.
setupPage.redetectHint: Installed one by hand? Re-detect looks again, no restart needed — this screen also checks when you come back to it.
setupPage.prerequisiteNoCommand: No install command is known for this machine — install it yourself, then check again.
setupPage.runYourself: Run this command yourself, then check again:
setupPage.serviceInstalledNotRunning: The service is registered but not running yet.
setupPage.handoverHint: It cannot start while this window runs the daemon itself. Finish here: Rooks then restarts on the service before the next step.
setupPage.loginHint: {name} is installed but has no credentials available to Rooks. Run {command} under the OS account running Rooks, then check again.
setupPage.backendsNone: No agent tool was found. Install one, or point Rooks at a binary you already have installed elsewhere.
setupPage.noProvider: No AI provider can run on this machine yet. Install one (or point Rooks at a binary you already have), then finish the setup.
setupPage.apiKeyTitle: Or use a provider with an API key
setupPage.apiKeyHint: These providers run through the Claude or Codex tool above. Once Rooks is installed, add your key in {settingsPath}, with “Add a provider”.

teamSetup.title: Start with a team that fits you.
teamSetup.description: Choose how you want to work. We’ll prepare the agents and their responsibilities — you give them their first mission.
teamSetup.choose: Choose a starting point to preview your team.
teamSetup.presetEditable: Whichever you pick, nothing is locked in: agents can be renamed, rewritten, added or removed at any time.

team.title: Agent Team
team.description: Four independent specialists. Talk directly to the one you need.
team.preview: Four independent agents, each working directly with you.

scratch.title: Start from scratch
scratch.description: An empty workspace for building your own agents and workflows.
scratch.preview: Your workspace starts empty. Create your first agent whenever you’re ready.

assistant.title: Personal Assistant
assistant.description: Helps organize priorities and prepare decisions.

writer.title: Writing
writer.description: Drafts, edits and clarifies your content.

developer.title: Development
developer.description: Helps build, understand and test software.

teamSetup.noAutomaticWork: You stay in control. No mission or recurring task starts automatically. All agents can be edited later.
teamSetup.loadFailed: Unable to load onboarding. Check your connection and try again.
teamSetup.failed: Your team could not be fully created. Try again to continue where it stopped.
teamSetup.backend_unavailable: No agent tool is available. Install or connect one, then try again, or start from scratch.
teamSetup.workspace_unavailable: The working folder is unavailable. Check its location and access permissions, then try again.
teamSetup.agent_conflict: A starter agent has been changed since creation began. Your changes were kept; resolve the conflict before retrying.
teamSetup.preset_locked: Team creation has already started. Resume the selected team.
teamSetup.instance_not_empty: Rooks already holds agents or work of your own. Choose Start from scratch to keep everything as it is and finish setup.
teamSetup.team_unavailable: Team setup is not available on this installation.
teamSetup.unavailableDescription: Starter teams are offered only during the first setup of an empty installation. Your existing agents are unchanged.
teamSetup.readyDescription: Everyone has a role. Give your team a first goal when you’re ready.
teamSetup.emptyNext: Create your first agent and shape your own way of working.
teamSetup.restartNext: One last step: restarting the daemon so it reads your configuration.

mainAgentSetup.title: Meet your main agent.
mainAgentSetup.description: This is your instance’s main orchestrator: the agent you talk to and who delegates to the others. Give it a name and a face — Rooks will use them everywhere.
mainAgentSetup.loadFailed: Unable to load this step. Check your connection and try again.
mainAgentSetup.avatarHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF. Optional — an initial is used otherwise.
mainAgentSetup.name: Name
mainAgentSetup.nameHint: How you will call it, in the cockpit and in every conversation.
mainAgentSetup.nameNormalized: Rooks will store this agent as “{id}”.
mainAgentSetup.objectivePlaceholder: Keep my week organized and prepare my decisions.
mainAgentSetup.objectiveHint: What this agent is for, in one sentence. It shapes how it answers.
mainAgentSetup.soulPlaceholder: Direct and concise. Says when something is uncertain. Never starts work without asking.
mainAgentSetup.soulHint: Its character and its ground rules. Saved as SOUL.md next to the agent — editable at any time.
mainAgentSetup.editableLater: Nothing here is final. Name, picture and instructions can be changed at any time from the agent page.
mainAgentSetup.failed: Your agent could not be saved. Try again.
mainAgentSetup.invalid_identity: Check the name and try again.
mainAgentSetup.invalid_name: This name contains no letter or digit Rooks can use. Try another one.
mainAgentSetup.name_taken: An agent already goes by this name. Choose another one.
mainAgentSetup.invalid_avatar: This picture is not one Rooks stored. Upload it again.
mainAgentSetup.workspace_unavailable: The workspace could not be opened. Check the workspace folder in setup and try again.
mainAgentSetup.rename_failed: The agent could not be renamed. Try again in a moment.
mainAgentSetup.main_agent_unavailable: No main agent was found on this installation. Continue — you can create one later.

restartStep.title: One last step: restart Rooks.
restartStep.description: Your configuration is written. The daemon reads it once, at startup — it is still running on the settings you just replaced, so it has to be restarted before you enter your workspace.
restartStep.loadFailed: Unable to reach the daemon. Check that it is running and try again.
restartStep.waitingHint: Waiting for the daemon to come back. This usually takes a few seconds.
restartStep.manualHint: Run this command, then come back to this screen — it detects the new daemon on its own.
restartStep.timedOut: The daemon has not come back yet. Run the command above, or check its logs.
restartStep.failed: The restart could not be started. Use the command above instead.
restartStep.unsupervisedHint: This machine has no service manager, so nothing can restart the daemon for you. You can continue — your configuration will be read the next time it starts.
restartStep.doneDescription: The daemon restarted and is now running on your configuration.

providerClis.loading: Looking for the AI CLIs on this machine…
providerClis.unavailable: The AI CLIs of this machine cannot be listed right now.
providerClis.updateCheckOff: Update checks are switched off (setting « Check for CLI updates »).
providerClis.startFailed: Rooks could not start the installer. Try again, or run the command yourself.
providerClis.manual: The official installer, to paste in a terminal:
providerClis.unsupportedVersion: {name} {version} found. Rooks's installer does not support this version, so it leaves it alone: neither install nor update is offered.

signInOutcome.terminal: Typed in Rooks's terminal: press Enter there and follow the steps in your browser, then click Try again.
signInOutcome.copied: Command copied. Paste it into a terminal on this machine, press Enter and follow the steps in your browser, then click Try again.
signInOutcome.failed: Rooks could not copy the command: select it below and run it in a terminal on this machine.

providerClis.signInThen: If it asks, type {command} and press Enter.
providerClis.signInHint: Then sign in: open a NEW terminal, run this and follow the steps in your browser. Already signed in? Click Try again.
providerClis.bundledSignInHint: Nothing to install: Rooks uses the CLI that ships with the desktop app. Sign it in once: open a NEW terminal, run this and follow the steps in your browser, then click Try again.

onboarding.title: Your AIs
onboarding.body: Rooks works through the AI tools you already have: Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Grok, Copilot… Install at least one here and sign in to it. You can add the others at any time in {settingsPath}.
onboarding.needOne: Install and sign in to Claude, Codex, Grok or Copilot to continue.

settings.title: AI tools on this machine
settings.description: Install an AI CLI with its vendor's official installer, sign it in, and update it when a new version is out. Rooks checks for updates at startup and then every few hours.

state.bundled: Ships with the desktop app, not signed in

signInOutcome.terminal: Typed in Rooks's terminal: press Enter there and finish in your browser. Rooks checks again when you come back.
signInOutcome.copied: Command copied: paste it into a terminal on this machine, press Enter and finish in your browser. Rooks checks again when you come back.
signInOutcome.failed: Rooks could not copy the command: run it yourself in a terminal on this machine.
